title: A Sponsor Wants “More Drama”
flavour: They have a suitcase of GP and absolutely no understanding of sport.

choices.label: TAKE THE MONEY
choices.desc: Gain Barry’s Burger Cart. Your next opponent starts 18 match points ahead.

choices.label: KEEP IT PURE
choices.desc: Upgrade two random Tactic cards for this run.

choices.label: MAKE IT WEIRD
choices.desc: Add Dopey Dom and remove a random Starter card.

title: Training in a Thunderstorm
flavour: The groundskeeper says this is “probably legal”.

choices.label: FLY THROUGH IT
choices.desc: Upgrade every Flying card for this run. Start next match with -8 Control.

choices.label: STUDY THE WEATHER
choices.desc: Gain the Possessed Weather Vane relic, but next reward offers only two cards.

choices.label: GO INSIDE
choices.desc: Upgrade a Support and a Staff card. Boring. Sensible. Powerful.

title: Barry Has Started a Press Conference
flavour: Nobody remembers inviting him. There are somehow twelve microphones.

choices.label: LET HIM COOK
choices.desc: Start next match with 15 Fan Pressure, but force Dragonfire Storm.

choices.label: TAKE THE MIC
choices.desc: Duplicate your most-upgraded card. If tied, duplicate the one with the fewest copies.

choices.label: ESCAPE THROUGH A WINDOW
choices.desc: Gain a Mystery relic, but start next match with one fewer card in your opening hand.

title: A Rival Offers Their Playbook
flavour: They swear it is not a trap, which is exactly what a trap would say.

choices.label: STEAL ONE PAGE
choices.desc: Add Swiped! and gain +1 opening Tempo next match.

choices.label: SWAP PLAYBOOKS
choices.desc: Transform three random cards into random unlocked cards.

choices.label: BURN IT
choices.desc: Remove one random card and gain +1 hand size for the next match.
